Theme strategy & light-mode look.light_mode_direction: Match other Strivo dashboard pages (bg-background / text-foreground / bg-card with subtle border).
Theme strategy & light-mode look.dark_mode_direction: Use semantic dark tokens (bg-background, bg-card) — drop literal bg-black so the page evolves with the system tokens.
Theme strategy & light-mode look.page_role: Reachable from elsewhere (nav/settings) in addition to post-signup — must read as a normal dashboard surface in both themes, not just as a one-time wow.
Theme strategy & light-mode look.theme_honor: Respect the user's current next-themes preference; no theme forcing on /celebrations.

Brand accent palette.hero_gradients: Keep the 3 expressive moments — (a) 'unfair advantage' indigo→violet→blue headline, (b) 'strive for excellence' yellow→orange→amber, (c) user #count indigo→violet→blue — but each gets a deliberate light-mode variant that still reads on a light background.
Brand accent palette.cta_button: Drop the indigo→purple CTA gradient. Use bg-primary / hover:bg-primary/90 to match standard Strivo buttons.
Brand accent palette.tile_icon_chip: bg-primary/10 + text-primary (was bg-indigo-500/20 with text-white icons).
Brand accent palette.signature_heart: Keep the red→pink SVG gradient as-is — small intentional warmth, theme-neutral.

Card primitive adoption.card_usage: All three card-like surfaces (audio player, letter, 3 action tiles) migrate to the shadcn <Card> primitive from src/components/ui/card.tsx — fulfills CELEB-03.
Card primitive adoption.action_tile_pattern: Card wrapped in React Router <Link>; hover state via hover:bg-accent or shadow lift. No <Button> conversion.
Card primitive adoption.letter_copy: Lowercase / handwritten prose unchanged. Theme work only — colors map text-white/* → text-foreground / text-muted-foreground so WCAG AA holds in both themes.
Card primitive adoption.spacing_rhythm: Keep current per-section spacing (min-h-[80vh] hero, py-20 / pb-16, max-w-2xl letter, max-w-4xl what's-next). Don't force a generic dashboard container.
